consequence.statement: The API server rejects v1beta1 SecretStore objects that use the fake provider when a data[] entry leaves out `value`.
consequence.remediation: Before applying the SecretStore, set `value` on every `spec.provider.fake.data[]` entry.

assertion.statement: In external-secrets 0.16.0, the external-secrets.io/v1beta1 SecretStore schema makes `spec.provider.fake.data[].value` required (the required list goes from ["key"] to ["key","value"]), so the API server rejects fake-provider data entries that leave out `value`.
